## Setup
```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
```

```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
load_data = T #Loading initial seurat analysis
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "supp_figS10_tss_integration_trial"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))

```


```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
clusters = tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
```

## RPCA, Harmony,  and FASTMNN
```{r}
dataname = "tss_integration_trial"
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```

```{r}
if (subset_data){
  tri = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  tri = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(tri) = "RNA"
}
tri
tri$cond.time = factor(tri$cond.time, c("white.day3","white.day1","asc.day0","beige.day1","beige.day3"))
tri$all = "1"
table(tri$cond.time)
```


## RPCA
```{r}
method_name="rpca"
red_name = method_name
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r rpcaA_init}
rpcaA = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "initial_clusters", cols=clusters, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white", shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, color="TSS clusters", y="UMAP 2") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, labels=function(x) paste0("t",x)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
rpcaA

rpcaA + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none")
```

```{r rpcaB_cond.time}
rpcaB = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "cond.time", cols=pal, 
               shuffle = T, shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, color="Sample", y="UMAP 2") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=pal) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
rpcaB

rpcaB + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none")
```


```{r rpcaC_new}
rpcaC = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white", shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, y="UMAP 2", colour=clu_name) + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
rpcaC

rpcaC + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none") 

```

## FastMNN 

```{r}
method_name="fastmnn"
red_name = method_name
umap_name = paste("umap", sep=".", method_name)
clu_name = paste( method_name, sep="_", "clusters")
```

```{r fastmnnA_init}
fastmnnA = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "initial_clusters", cols=clusters, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, label.color="white", shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, color="TSS clusters", y="UMAP 2",x= "UMAP 1") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=clusters, labels=function(x) paste0("t",x)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
fastmnnA

fastmnnA + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none")
```

```{r fastmnnB_cond.time}
fastmnnB = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = "cond.time", cols=pal, 
               shuffle = T, shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
    labs(title=NULL, color="Sample", y="UMAP 2", "UMAP 1") + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=pal) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
fastmnnB

fastmnnB + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none")
```


```{r fastmnnC_new}
fastmnnC = DimPlot(tri, reduction = umap_name,  group.by = clu_name, shuffle = T,
               label=T, label.box=T, shape.by = "all") + theme_hp +
     labs(title=NULL, y="UMAP 2", x="UMAP 1")  + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = 1, guide="none")
fastmnnC

fastmnnC + scale_shape_manual(values=NA, guide="none") 
```

### get legends
```{r legends_only}
initial_clu = get_legend(rpcaA + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top"))
cond.time = get_legend(rpcaB + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow=2, byrow=T,
                                                            override.aes = list(size = 3)) ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top"))

legend_plot = plot_grid(initial_clu, cond.time, nrow=1)
legend_plot
```


## Combined plot


```{r}
umaps = plot_grid(rpcaA +labs(x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          rpcaB +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          rpcaC+labs(y=NULL,x=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyA +labs(x=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyB +labs(x=NULL, y=NULL)+theme(legend.position = "none"),
          harmonyC +labs(y=NULL,x=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnA +labs() +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnB +labs(y=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          fastmnnC +labs(y=NULL) +theme(legend.position = "none"),
          ncol = 3)
```


```{r all_plots}
plot_grid(umaps, legend_plot, 
          rel_heights = c(1,0.15), ncol=1)  
ggsave(here(fig_dir, "tss_integration_trial.png"), width = 18, height= 18, units="cm", dpi = 600)
```
